name: sgarcese-housing-dashboards
description: Housing dashboards, refreshes and briefs for any U.S. city or county from Census ACS, BLS and HUD open data: demand and tenure, construction costs and labor, and federally assisted housing, compared with the surrounding region, state and nation.

io.github.ai-lab-for-cities-at-harvard.civic.use-when: A U.S. city, county or state wants a housing needs snapshot, dashboard, refresh or council brief that compares local demand, construction costs and assisted housing with its region and the nation, from public Census, BLS and HUD data.
io.github.ai-lab-for-cities-at-harvard.civic.avoid-when: Outside the U.S. Not for parcel-level, permit, eviction or individual household decisions, and not a substitute for a formal housing needs assessment or Consolidated Plan without staff checking the figures.
